level2.title: Loaves and Fishes
level2.story: Jesus spoke to the crowds about the kingdom of God and healed those who needed healing. As evening came, the Twelve said, "Send away the multitude," but Jesus said, "Give you them to eat." They had only five loaves and two fishes for about five thousand men. Jesus took the loaves and fish, looked up to heaven, blessed them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples. All ate and were filled, and twelve baskets of fragments were left.
level2.keyLine: They did all eat and were filled.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How do Jesus' actions match the Mass?

level2.prayer: Jesus in the Blessed Sacrament, I adore You. Amen.
